entities.summary: Wang Shih-chien is a Taiwanese politician and businessman. A member of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), he has served as a member of the Legislative Yuan representing Taipei City Constituency 2. He previously served on the Taipei City Council from 1998 to 2005 and was also a legislator from 2005 to 2008.
